scope.backend_tests: Production handlers with in-memory SQLite and Durable Object storage fixtures; no test scores submitted to production

fixed_findings.impact: Activating Jewelria deleted every other application's cache on the same origin, removing other games' offline assets.
fixed_findings.evidence: Failed before correction; unit test and real Chromium installation/offline navigation passed afterwards.

fixed_findings.impact: Shared workers stored all navigation responses under index.html, mixing languages. Clean URLs and .html aliases could miss the requested document and fall back to the wrong language.
fixed_findings.fix: Cache documents by normalized language-specific URL; normalize index aliases and discard navigation query strings; return unavailable when that document is absent.
fixed_findings.evidence: KO/EN/JA offline alias tests passed in unit tests and actual Chromium.

fixed_findings.impact: Global cache searches could serve an old shared script from another game's cache after an update.
fixed_findings.fix: Restrict every active fetch-path cache lookup to the current game's current cache.
fixed_findings.evidence: A stale shared asset seeded in another cache no longer shadows the network/current cache.

fixed_findings.impact: A cache read error caused an unavailable response even when the network could serve the requested asset.
fixed_findings.fix: Treat cache read failure as a miss and continue with network delivery.
fixed_findings.evidence: Injected cache read failures now return the successful network response.

fixed_findings.impact: Holding movement or jump while switching away from the game could leave input held because keyup/touchend never arrived.
fixed_findings.fix: Release keyboard and touch state on blur, hidden document and game transitions; send the neutral state to the multiplayer host; remove added listeners on destroy.
fixed_findings.evidence: Actual Chrome reproduced stuck movement at both viewports before the fix and cleared it after the fix; tests also cover host notification and stale touch movement.

fixed_findings.impact: Accessing a blocked localStorage getter aborted initialization of the entire shared runtime.
fixed_findings.fix: Guard storage acquisition so preference reads return fallbacks and failed persistence returns false.
fixed_findings.evidence: A SecurityError getter fixture previously failed initialization and now passes.

fixed_findings.impact: Late start/flush responses in the shared RankingClient could replace a new session, disable it, consume new events or release a new upload's lock. This is a latent shared API defect; the games' separate ranking clients already had their own isolation tests.
fixed_findings.fix: Bind asynchronous work to a run token and captured session/queue; clear only the matching upload promise; prevent an old submission from attaching to a restarted session.
fixed_findings.evidence: Out-of-order start successes/failures, old uploads, simultaneous new uploads and stale submissions are covered.

fixed_findings.impact: Null payloads/commands could throw and become retryable 503 errors; numeric IDs passed regex coercion and reached persistence.
fixed_findings.fix: Validate object shapes and string identifiers before invoking the Durable Object; malformed requests return 400.
fixed_findings.evidence: Eight invalid-envelope cases return 400 without a persistence call; existing successful ranking delivery and recovery tests also pass.

fixed_findings.impact: The Vite development server resolved shared files from the wrong parent and omitted required shared scripts, returning 500/404.
fixed_findings.fix: Resolve an explicit public asset allowlist relative to server.config.root; support root and /water-sort/ URLs; forward filesystem errors to Vite.
fixed_findings.evidence: Live local requests changed from 500/404 to 200; the regression test checks the actual page script references and injected runtime against repository bytes.

dependency_fixes.miniflare_sharp_override: 0.35.5; patch override retained until the upstream Miniflare dependency includes this security fix

verification.ci_improvement: Offline worker lifecycle regression added to the shared-and-assets job; new unit tests included in the existing matrix
verification.additional_browser_cases: Solo Leveling character selection/combat at both viewports; Water Sort launch at both viewports after rebuilding with patched Vite
verification.visual_result: All 20 title screenshots match baseline pixels exactly, using the final rebuilt Water Sort screenshots. No CSS, visible text or artwork changes. Gameplay screens were also captured and reviewed.

visible_change_pending_user_direction.condition: 390x844 portrait viewport after entering fullscreen gameplay
visible_change_pending_user_direction.finding: The ArcherLab link overlaps the remaining-time and score HUD; this already occurs on the baseline commit.
visible_change_pending_user_direction.cause: The shared fullscreen rule places .archerlab-link at top:88px over Jewelria's game HUD.
visible_change_pending_user_direction.disposition: No visible positioning change applied: workspace AGENTS.md requires separate explicit approval. User direction requested while the nonvisual fixes continue to deployment.

coverage_limits_and_followups: This review establishes the tested behavior, not the absence of every possible bug.
Actual Safari/Firefox/iOS devices and live two-player relay/WebRTC matches were not covered. Extend browser/device CI and add a two-client network integration scenario.
The smoke runs are short. Existing unit/browser tests cover scoring, persistence, restart and asset lifecycle; they do not constitute completion of every level with every character.
Recheck and remove the narrow Sharp override when Miniflare ships a patched dependency.
